blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — A woman allegedly raped by British comedian Russell Brand more than two decades ago told a court Thursday she was “terrified” and he became “monster-like” before attacking her in a hotel room. The jury at a London trial heard testimony from a woman who has accused Brand of raping her in Bournemouth, southern England, in 1999 when he was acting in a theatre show at the Labour Party Conference.
